why: An October 2025 preprint by Akram Louiz claims a disproof of the Twin Primes Conjecture that also proves no Siegel zeros exist, via Heath-Brown's theorem, with a claimed Lean formal verification. Yitang Zhang's related 'no Landau-Siegel zeros' proof claim (arXiv 2211.02515) predates the January 2024 snapshot and is unresolved/unpublished, so it is not itself new progress but shows the question was already contested pre-snapshot.
